sections.title: Employ210 Updates
sections.body:
This week, significant progress was made on the **Employ210** application, focusing on enhancing the **SOP/custom instruction grounding feature**. This feature allows users to input instructions or upload a PDF, which the **HTA generator** uses to align every step with the provided SOP throughout the generation process.

Key Achievements:
- The **AWS Lambda** backend was updated to incorporate the **custom_instructions** field into the pipeline while maintaining the existing 3-pass structure.
- A **maintenance mode toggle** was added to improve system management.
- A **FEATURE_SPEC.md** document was created for **Claude Code** to standardize feature specifications.
- A full cinematic product explainer **HTML animation** was developed, showcasing the end-to-end **HTA flow** with **AWS Lambda** branding.

sections.title: S&CC Updates
sections.body:
Significant progress was made on the **SNCC** project this week, focusing on both a research paper and a grant application.

Key Achievements:
- A full **IEEE-format paper draft** was developed, targeting the **IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics**. During this process, a data integrity issue was identified, resulting in a verified accuracy of **75.3%** with a **kappa** of **0.60**. This was a decrease from the earlier **90%** figure, likely due to a change in the **Gemini model version**.

Issues Identified & Fixed:
- The data integrity issue was addressed, and the impact of the **Gemini model version** change was analyzed.

Grant Application Review:
- **Katie's** grant proposal for **SNCC** was reviewed. A feedback PDF was drafted, highlighting gaps in the technical narrative and suggesting enhancements.

Technology Highlights for Proposal:
| Technology Highlight       | Description                                |
|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| **Streamformer**           | A key technology to be emphasized          |
| **LoRA**                   | Suggested for inclusion in the proposal    |
| **Hybrid Gemini Pipeline** | Recommended for strengthening the proposal |
| **Multimodal Grounding**   | Highlighted as a significant feature       |
| **RLHF Feedback Loop**     | Proposed as a critical component           |

These highlights were recommended to strengthen the proposal for reviewers.
